row.scim_price_text: Enterprise: US$20/seat/mo billed annually + usage at API rates
row.evidence: Claude's pricing page lists SCIM only on Enterprise ($20 per seat per month plus usage billed at API rates), and the help centre says SCIM is not available for Team plans.
row.notes: Team ($20/seat/mo annual Standard, $100 Premium; 2 to 150 seats) includes SAML/OIDC SSO and JIT; SCIM directory sync, audit logs, the Compliance API and the Admin API member endpoints are Enterprise-only. Enterprise is a $20/seat/mo seat fee plus usage billed at API rates, so per-user price and multiplier stay null. SCIM runs through WorkOS: admins copy a WorkOS SCIM base URL and token into a custom IdP app; Okta's catalogue 'Claude' app is SAML/agent-governance only. SCIM removal removes the member from the org; re-adding the same email restores chats and projects. Console (API platform) organizations with their own parent org can also use SCIM.

auth.token_source: Claude admin settings > Organization and access > User provisioning > Setup SCIM (WorkOS setup flow provides the SCIM base URL and token)

operations.notes: Okta's setup enables Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users; an IdP deactivation or unassignment removes the member from the Claude org. PUT vs PATCH handling is in the WorkOS layer and not documented by Anthropic.

deprovision.data_retained: Member is removed from the organization. Their chats (including shared snapshots) become inaccessible to remaining members; org-shared projects stay available; data stays in Primary Owner exports and Enterprise retention settings; re-adding the same email restores chats, projects and skills.

attributes.notes: Anthropic documents only that the SCIM email attribute must match the SSO email; the full attribute list is handled by WorkOS and not published by Anthropic.

roles.how: IdP group mappings set org role (Owner, Admin, User, Custom) and seat tier; Custom-role permissions come from SCIM-synced groups

rate_limits.text: Claude polls WorkOS for SCIM update events every minute; syncs are eventually consistent (minutes, sometimes hours).

limitations.text: Not available on Team plans; Team gets JIT only, and JIT never removes members automatically.
Updating a member's email creates a new member record and removes the old one.
Switching provisioning mode to SCIM removes members not in the IdP directory; Owners and Admins not in a mapped role group are removed when group mappings are enabled.
The Primary Owner is exempt from SCIM reconciliation and cannot be assigned through SCIM group mappings.
Microsoft Entra pushes SCIM changes only every 40 minutes.

capabilities.notes: Members join by accepting an invite or via SSO; there is no create-user call. Role updates are limited to user and managed.

endpoints.purpose: Change a member's role (user or managed)
Remove a member (returns seat to pool)

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per minute per organization; invite creation 1,200 requests per hour.

limitations.text: When SCIM manages membership, member removals via the API return 400; orgs using JIT or SCIM cannot create invites via the API.
Administrative roles (owner, membership_admin, primary_owner) cannot be assigned, changed or removed through the API.

okta.notes: OIN 'Claude' app is marked SAML, Cross App Access and AI Agent Providers (imports Claude managed agents), not SCIM. Anthropic's own guide has admins build a custom app (Create App Integration) and paste the WorkOS SCIM base URL and token.

entra.notes: Anthropic's guide says to pick 'Claude' from the gallery if available, otherwise create a non-gallery app; provisioning uses the WorkOS tenant URL and token. Gallery listing not checked on Microsoft's site.

google.notes: Anthropic's Google guide describes a custom SAML app plus Google 'Configure autoprovisioning'; the JIT/SCIM article links WorkOS Google Directory Sync instead.

onelogin.notes: From Anthropic's OneLogin guide (SCIM base URL and bearer token from WorkOS); OneLogin catalogue not checked.

jumpcloud.notes: Anthropic's JIT/SCIM article links WorkOS JumpCloud SAML and SCIM guides; no JumpCloud catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.notes: JIT on Team and Enterprise (SAML or OIDC via WorkOS); JIT never removes members. Members list can be exported to CSV; CSV import not documented.
